history_scope: All reachable commit messages and text-file patches at the pinned tested implementation commit; no missing patch records
rotation_action: If an actual production credential is identified, revoke/rotate at its issuer, replace the scoped local binding, remove exposed current material and re-scan; a commit deletion does not revoke a credential.
limitations: Pattern scan cannot recognize every possible arbitrary credential string.
External provider accounts, private local credentials and other repositories are outside this repository scan.
